description: Golf booking automation executed and created booking 6O9S-0U0U (Saturday, September 5, 2026 at 5:15 PM) for 4 players. User correction: This booking overlaps with an existing tee time and is for the wrong party size. The correct booking should be for 2 players (David + Susie O'Hara), not 4. The automated booking (6O9S-0U0U) will be cancelled manually by David.
what_happened: Skill executed with party-size logic that selected 4 players. Per MANDATORY EXECUTION RULE #6 (revised in err-20260813T122308-08TG1R), the default is now 4 players 'unless preview-output.json explicitly specifies a different party size'. The preview-output.json for this run did not contain a party_size override field, so the automation defaulted to 4. However, David's actual intent for this booking was 2 players (David + Susie), and there was already a booking in place for that date/time.
correction_required: 1. Booking 6O9S-0U0U (4 players, 5:15 PM) will be cancelled by David manually. 2. Revert the SKILL.md logic: the automation should default to 2 players (David + Susie) for Saturday bookings unless preview-output.json explicitly includes a 'party_size' field specifying otherwise. 3. Add a 'party_size' field to preview-output.json template to make overrides explicit.
systemic_fix_needed: 1. SKILL.md MANDATORY EXECUTION RULE #6: Change back to 'Always book 2 players (David + Susie O'Hara)' unless preview-output.json.party_size specifies a different size. 2. Add schema validation to preview-output.json to include optional party_size field (default: 2). 3. Update Step 4c player-selection logic to read preview-output.json.party_size and default to 2 if not specified.
notes: This is a regression of err-20260813T122308-08TG1R. The rule was changed to default to 4 players, but this is incorrect for the typical golf booking workflow. The correct logic is: default to 2 players (David + Susie), and override to larger party only if preview-output.json explicitly specifies party_size. The August 13 error entry misunderstood the correction and applied the wrong default.
